title: run-134: The species pruning pass: cross-file BASE pins and pinned-elsewhere duplicates go, each proven by the guard that survives
body: **Claim:** Every test that byte-pins BASE text of a file outside its subject's Files, and every duplicate assertion the readers marked pinned-elsewhere, is deleted, and each deletion is proven by a Run: that shows the surviving pin (a grep of the remaining test) still guards the behaviour; the plan lists each deleted test by file and name. (quoted from #779)
